title: Business Development Intern
description:

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.
* Interest in real estate, urban planning, design, or related domains is an advantage.

title: Product Sales Manager - Bangalore
description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





 To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /

 The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.
   

  





 At SKF, we provide industry\-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day\-to\-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.

 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

 Individual Contribution
   

  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore

**Candidate Background and competencies**




****Education \& Experience****




 Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent. Master’s degree in sales and marketing management is an added advantage.
   

  





 6 \- 8 years of experience in industrial product sales, preferably in sales of bearings, housings with significant exposure to Key Account Management both large OEM, end\-user \& distribution channel.
   

  





**Competencies**




 Optimistic, results\-orientated, “play\-to\-win” attitude and entrepreneurial spirit.
   

  





 Excellent business acumen with proven track records in sales.
   

  





 Flexible mind\-set \& strong leadership skills with capability to adapt to a dynamic environment and drive change.
   

  





 Enjoy working in across regions / international networks and the ability to inspire and influence people in a matrix environment \-– influencing without authority is a key trait.
   

  





 Strong communicator who is organized, structured and a good critical thinker

 Team player

****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
**Who are we?**


 At
 
**Pibit** 

 , we’re on a mission to rescue commercial insurance from the dark ages of PDFs, Excel chaos, and
 
*“Did anyone reply to that broker email?”* 

 We’re a
 
**Series A** 

 ,
 
**Y\-Combinator backed** 

 startup that helps insurance carriers and MGAs make sense of messy submission documents. Think of us as the data janitors for underwriting with a PhD in AI, allowing us to move with both speed and technical rigor.
 





 We’re proudly headquartered in
 
**San Jose** 

 , but the real magic happens in
 
**Bangalore** 

 , where our
 
**sales, AI, and engineering teams** 

 fuel the ship (with coffee, code, and questionable memes). We operate as a
 
**globally distributed team** 

 , building together across time zones.
 




  






 We’re not just building products, we’re developing
 
**cutting\-edge, core AI technologies** 

 that make us a true
 
**disruptor in the commercial insurance space** 

 . Our leadership team brings
 
**60\+ years of experience** 

 from top tech companies and includes alumni of
 
**India’s prestigious IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology)** 

 , because someone had to keep the rest of us humble. We’ve built and maintained an elite, product\-driven culture from day one.
 




  






 We’re a fast\-growing crew of
 
**under 100 people** 

 , aiming to
 
**double by next year** 

 , which means
 
**plenty of room to grow, build, and lead** 

 . We work hard, get things done, and party even harder. Our offsites happen twice a year and they’re the kind of fun that makes you forget we’re building enterprise SaaS.
 




  





  





  




**What’s Expected From You (Besides Knowing How to Use a Calendar)**


 As our
 
**Account Executive** 

 , you’ll be chasing down clients with annual revenues between $10 million and $1 billion aka, companies big enough to have meetings about meetings, but small enough to still answer your emails.
 




  






 At Pibit, your mission (and yes, you
 
*should* 

 choose to accept it) is to hunt down new logos in the
 
**U.S. insurance jungle:** 

 carriers, MGAs, and other acronym\-loving entities. No hand\-holding, no babysitting. We’re looking for someone who can run the full sales cycle from “Hi, nice to e\-meet you” to “Here’s the signed contract, let’s party.”
 




  





**You’ll own everything:** 

 cold outreach, dazzling demos, stakeholder herding, contract negotiations, CRM updates (you
 
*will* 

 update the CRM), and closing deals that make our CFO smile. Your target?
 
**$450K in ARR.** 

 Yes, it’s ambitious but so are we.
 




  






 Bonus points if you speak fluent insurance lingo and don’t break into a cold sweat when someone says “underwriting workflows.”
 




  





**Basically:** 

 sell smart, sell hard, and don’t forget to bring snacks for the ride.
 




  





  





  




**You’ll crush it in this role if:**
* **You’ve been around the SaaS block:** 

 6\+ years of B2B sales experience. You’ve danced the quota tango before and won.
* **You’re a sales ninja:** 

 Objection handling? Solution design? Complex negotiation? You’ve got the skills and the stories.
* **You speak human:** 

 You can explain technical stuff to non\-technical folks without using phrases like “synergize the paradigm.”
* **You don’t need babysitting:** 

 You take initiative, follow up like a pro, and don’t wait for someone to tell you it’s time to prospect.
* **You speak fluent Hubspot:** 

 CRM hygiene is your thing (you even clean up other people’s messes). Bonus if you’ve wrangled tools like SalesNav, Lusha, DataNyze, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and can politely threaten a sales ops person.
* **This role comes with passport stamps:** 

 Expect to spend at least 30 days a year in the U.S. meeting clients, closing deals, and possibly learning what “biscuits and gravy” actually means.
* **Insurance doesn’t scare you:** 

 You know what an MGA is (and didn’t Google it just now). Bonus points if you’ve dealt with underwriting or claims workflows without falling asleep.



  





  





  





  




**Key Responsibilities:**

**Full Sales Cycle \& Prospecting:** 

 Own the end\-to\-end sales process for enterprise insurance accounts from that first cold email to contract signature (and maybe a virtual high five). You’ll be hunting, not gathering so bring your best outreach game and build a pipeline that even CRM dashboards will be proud of.
 




  





**Solution Selling \& Demos:** 

 Deliver tailored demos that make underwriters say, “Wait… you can do
 
*that* 

 ?” Translate Pibit’s magic into real\-world value, showing execs and ops teams how we make the mess go away (without smoke and mirrors).
 




  





**Stakeholder Engagement:** 

 Build strong relationships with underwriting, claims, IT, and anyone else with a stake in making insurance suck less. Be their go\-to person, therapist, and strategic advisor, all rolled into one.
 




  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 

 Work closely with Sales Engineers, Product, and Customer Success aka your internal Avengers to deliver proof\-of\-concepts that wow and implementations that don’t require a prayer circle.
 




  





**Pipeline \& Forecast Management:** 

 Keep the CRM squeaky clean (we see you, pipeline hoarders). Forecast like a weather app that actually gets it right.
 
**The goal: hit your $450K ARR target like it’s just another Tuesday.** 




  





**Account Growth:** 

 You’re mostly chasing new logos, but hey, if you spot upsell or cross\-sell potential, don’t leave money on the table. Be opportunistic (in a charming way).
 




  




**Why Join Pibit? (Besides the fact that we’re awesome)**
* **Get in early:** 

 Join a rocket ship while it’s still on the launchpad (bonus: you get to help build the rocket).



  




* Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founding team. Yes, they’re real people, and no, they don’t bite.



  




* Tackle real\-world headaches like PDFs, emails, and “just one more attachment” with an AI\-native product that actually does what it says.



  




* Leave your ego at the door. We care more about impact than job titles (but if you want to be “Head of Making Magic Happen,” we’re open to it).



  




* Competitive compensation, zero corporate fluff, and a career trajectory that’s basically a vertical line.



  




* Fast growth \= fast promotions. You won’t be stuck waiting for Rahul to retire so you can get that next title.



  




* Our offsites? Legendary. Our memes? Questionable. Our team? Unbeatable.



  





  






 Pibit is an equal opportunity employer. We love brains of all kinds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive crew. Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just say the word, we’ve got you.

 Salary: \- Rs 18,000\-Rs 34,000
   




 About Paws\&Collars
 
 Paws\&Collars is a 360° pet care and wellness brand focused on helping pets live healthier, happier and longer lives.
 



 Our services include veterinary care, preventive wellness, grooming \& spa, pet hotel, daycare, pharmacy, retail and pet community experiences.
 



 We are looking for a confident, customer\-focused and organized Front Desk \& Pet Wellness Executive to become the first point of contact for our pet parents and play an important role in building long\-term customer relationships.
 



 This is not a traditional reception role. The position combines front\-desk management, outbound calling, appointment coordination, customer relationship management, retail sales and pet wellness education.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  




 1\. Front Desk \& Customer Experience
 * Welcome pet parents and their pets warmly and professionally.
* Manage the front desk and ensure a smooth customer experience.
* Handle customer enquiries through phone, WhatsApp and in\-person interactions.
* Understand customer requirements and guide them to the appropriate Paws\&Collars service.
* Handle customer concerns professionally and escalate issues to the appropriate team.

* Follow up on enquiries, missed appointments and pending bookings.
* Contact customers for grooming, veterinary, wellness, daycare and boarding reminders.

As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Bangalore

 The

 You’ll partner with Account Executives, senior Industry Principals, Business Consultants, and Industry Marketing to sharpen our industry content, discovery workshops, develop ROI and TCO models, and translate operational improvements into credible financial outcomes.
   

  

 What you will do

title: Founding Key Account Manager
description:
**About Fabric** 




 Fabric is an AI hiring platform. Companies use our AI interviews, sourcing agents, and cheating detection to screen and hire at scale. We've run over 100,000 interviews for customers including Meesho, CRED, and Kearney.
 



  





**The role** 




 Most of our revenue sits in our top 10\-12 accounts, and today the founders manage those relationships ourselves. You'll be our first account management hire. You'll take over the top of the book and grow it, and you'll build the playbook that every account hire after you will run.
 



 This is a founding role in the real sense: no team under you yet, no existing process, direct work with all four founders, and a real say in what we build.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* The top 10\-12 customer accounts and the relationships with their TA and HR leadership
* Renewals and retention across your book. You should know an account is at risk 90 days before the renewal call
* Expansion: growing usage inside accounts and landing new teams and business units within existing customers
* QBRs, account plans, and the health signals that tell us which accounts need attention this week
* Customer feedback into product. You'll sit close enough to the founders that what you hear in accounts changes the roadmap



  





**What success looks like after 12 months** 



* Zero regretted churn in your book
* Your accounts have grown in usage and revenue against a number you carry
* Every key account has a live account plan and a QBR rhythm that actually happens
* Three or four of your accounts are referenceable: case studies, intros, references on sales calls



  





**You're probably a fit if** 



* You have 3\-6 years in account management or customer success at a
 **HR tech company** 
 , with a retention or expansion quota you can describe in numbers
* You've grown accounts yourself and can walk through exactly how, deal by deal
* You've operated without much support infrastructure and built your own process where none existed
* You can go deep on product. Our customers ask hard questions about how AI interviews and cheating detection work, and you'll need real answers
* You're comfortable presenting to CHROs and TA heads, and just as comfortable pulling the usage data yourself



  





**This role is a bad fit if** 



* Your best work happened with CS, solutions engineers, and marketing doing the heavy lifting around you
* You want a team to manage on day one
* Customers love you but your accounts never grew



  





**Compensation** 




 Base plus a variable tied to retention and expansion in your book. Founding\-level ESOPs on top.
 



  





**How we hire** 



1. Fabric’s AI interview.
2. Founder intro call
3. An assignment
4. Assignment review \+ meeting with other co\-founders

description:
****Who we are:****
 80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity.Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers — and the people supporting them — to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.We are a remote\-first, global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India. We are backed by leading investors including Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Zinier is looking for a sharp, analytical generalist to work closely with senior leadership on business development, partnerships, strategy, and company building. Think of it as the work of a strong consulting Associate, but from inside a growth\-stage B2B SaaS company.
   

  

 You will not need prior expertise in every area. What matters is your ability to
 **learn quickly, think clearly, communicate simply, and execute with high quality.**
**What You Will Work On**
* Business development: Understand client and partner problems, shape solutions, and build the pitch decks and proposals that go into those conversations.
* Partnerships: Research potential partners, build partnership theses, and support leadership in partner discussions.
* Strategy and M\&A: Map markets, evaluate acquisition opportunities, and turn research into clear recommendations.
* GTM and company initiatives: Support strategic projects across sales, marketing, and customer success, including OKR reviews and business cases.
* Executive communication: Turn rough inputs and complex information into polished, executive\-ready presentations and content.


 At its core, the role asks you to take a problem such as
 *'We are meeting this partner; figure out why they should work with Zinier'* 
 and drive it from research to a finished pitch.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
**Must haves**
* 1–3 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, business strategy, or a similarly analytical and high\-ownership environment.
* Direct, client\-facing experience.
* A bachelor's or master's degree from a Tier 1 institution (an MBA is not required).


**You will thrive here if you**
* Break down ambiguous problems and form a clear point of view, rather than simply summarising research.

* Pick up unfamiliar industries and business models quickly, with genuine commercial curiosity.
* Work independently, care about quality, and see work through to completion.

**Nice to have:** 
 Exposure to B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or field service; experience with pitch decks, proposals, or M\&A; or experience supporting founders and senior executives.
   

  

**Why This Role**
 You will work across business development, partnerships, GTM, strategy, and M\&A rather than being confined to a single function. Working closely with senior leadership, you will see your work directly shape customer conversations, partnerships, and strategic decisions, and grow into someone who can own business problems end\-to\-end.

 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. You'll work with world\-class merchants, technology, and colleagues while selling the best to the best.

 Being able to tell stories is fundamental to how we operate. Our team is fantastic storytellers when speaking to prospective and current clients to foster excitement about our product and strengthen customer relations. We are looking for a sales manager who will succeed aboard the Adyen rocket ship and take our current successful momentum to the next level of growth through the acquisition of new (Enterprise) merchants.
   

  

 Sounds exciting? Keep reading!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the full sales cycle with our largest merchants \- from generating leads to closing deals to getting them live and transacting;
* Creatively drive innovation for merchants in retail, digital, platforms, and financial services;
* Become an expert in selling Adyen's world class financial solutions;
* Partner with technology leaders and solution providers while working closely with our Compliance, Implementation and Account Management teams;
* Work with the India team to provide inputs for building products for Indian merchants.
* Travel and network (\~25%);


*The role is a senior Individual Contributor sales position, rather than a people\-management role.*
**Who You Are**
* Proven experience in an enterprise sales role (5\+ years in enterprise sales) selling complex solutions;
* Strong experience and knowledge of payments ecosystem / PSPs / acquiring or related business
* You have a strong network of clients or industry expertise that is relevant for Adyen
* You are a team player who enjoys working in\-person with the sales team both locally and globally across different cultures, roles, and offices;
* You are an analytical, strategic negotiator with a commercially driven, go\-getting attitude;
* You are an excellent communicator of big ideas and can uncover complex needs internally and externally.
* You are a resourceful, super self\-starter and can execute and manage time\-sensitive tasks in a fast\-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment;

* English proficiency required.


**Ready to meet us?**

 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them \- voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
   

  

 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
   

  

**What’s next?**
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

title: Sr. Enrolment Advisor – Online Degree Programs, UK University (Ed-Tech / Online Higher-Ed Sales background required)
description:
**About Cintana Education:** 




 Cintana Education is a global higher education platform that works with select universities and higher education institutions to accelerate growth, improve academic quality, drive innovation, and strengthen student outcomes. Cintana acts as a strategic partner to higher education institutions across the world, bringing access to global academic expertise, operating capabilities, and the experience of leading universities, including Arizona State University, University of Technology Sydney, and other globally respected institutions. Cintana currently works across 25\+ countries and is headquartered in the United States.
 
  
 




  





**Website:** 
 https://cintana.com/
 



  





***Role Overview***




 As a Sr. Enrolment Advisor, you will drive enrolments and revenue for a premium British university's online degree and certificate portfolio \- including MBA, Psychology, Digital Marketing, and other in\-demand programs \- with an ARPU ranging from $3,000 to $10,000\. This is a high\-intensity, target\-driven sales role for someone with a proven ed\-tech background who knows how to sell online degrees and certificates, not just counsel prospects.
 



 This is an exciting opportunity offering a defined career pathway and excellent prospects for advancement for the right candidate.
 



  





***Role Description***




 Reporting to the Manager, Student Enrolment in London and with local line management in India, you will be part of an international student recruitment team selling online programs on behalf of an accredited UK institution. This role is built around hardcore, high\-volume sales execution: you will dial 120\+ outbound calls daily, run a multi\-channel cadence across phone, email, and WhatsApp, and be judged on your ability to consistently hit aggressive monthly enrolment and revenue targets.
 



 You will manage prospects through a multi\-week sales cycle \- from first contact to enrolment \- handling objections, and rejection along the way while staying focused on the close.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




**1\.    Sales \& Enrolment (Primary Focus)** 




 •      Own and exceed monthly/quarterly enrolment and revenue targets across MBA, Psychology, Digital Marketing and other online programs (ARPU $3,000–$10,000\).
 



 •      Dial 120\+ outbound calls daily to a pipeline of inbound and marketing\-generated leads — call volume is a non\-negotiable input KPI, not a guideline.
 



 •      Run structured, consultative sales conversations that uncover a prospect's goals, handle objections (cost, time commitment, credibility of online degrees), and close enrolments.
 



 •      Maintain consistent, high\-quality follow\-up across phone, email, and WhatsApp until a decision is reached — persistent without being pushy.
 



 •      Manage a multi\-week, multi\-cohort pipeline simultaneously, keeping every prospect warm and moving through the funnel.
 



 •      Handle live chat enquiries with speed and accuracy, converting real\-time interest into booked calls or applications.
 



 •      Schedule and run online info sessions, webinars, and 1:1 meetings that convert prospects into enrolled students.
 



  





**2\.    Target Management** 




 •      Perform consistently under the pressure of daily call quotas, weekly conversion targets, and month\-end enrolment deadlines.
 



 •      Stay composed and solution\-oriented when facing rejection, price objections, or slow\-moving prospects; recover quickly and keep pipeline momentum.
 



 •      Self\-prioritize a large, live pipeline daily, focusing on highest\-probability\-to\-close leads without dropping other follow\-ups.
 



  





**3\.    Admissions Counselling** 




 •      Advise prospects on programme fit, curriculum, career outcomes, and financing/payment plan options for online programs.
 



 •      Coordinate with UK\-based admissions and faculty for interviews or assessments as needed.
 



 •      Support application completion (transcripts, essays, documentation), ensuring accuracy and adherence to admissions requirements.
 



  





**4\.    Relationship Building \& Retention** 




 •      Build trust\-based relationships with prospects (and, where relevant, their families or employers) that hold up across a multi\-touch, multi\-week sales cycle.
 



 •      Represent the voice of the Asia market back to the university and marketing teams — feeding back on objections, competitor offers, and lead quality.
 



  





**5\.    CRM, Data \& Reporting** 




 •      Log every call, email, and WhatsApp touchpoint accurately in the CRM; maintain clean, complete data on every prospect.
 



 •      Track your own conversion metrics (calls made, connects, conversions) and use data to prioritize daily activity.
 



 •      Support enrolment dashboard reporting as required.
 



  





***About You — Please Apply If This Sounds Like You:***




 You are a hardcore sales professional who has thrived in high\-volume, high\-pressure outbound environments — not just someone who enjoys customer service. You've sold online education products before (degrees, certificates, bootcamps) and understand what it takes to convert a cold or lukewarm lead into a paying student at a $3,000–$10,000 price point.
 



 •      You have carried and consistently exceeded aggressive individual sales targets in a past role — ideally in ed\-tech, online degree/certificate sales, or a comparably high\-pressure B2C sales environment (insurance, fintech, subscription sales).
 



 •      You can sustain 120\+ outbound dials a day without burning out, and know how to work a multi\-channel cadence (calls \+ email \+ WhatsApp) to keep a prospect engaged.
 



 •      You absorb pressure well — deadlines and pushback don't rattle you; you adapt and keep closing.
 



 •      You are comfortable selling premium\-priced products and can confidently justify a $3,000–$10,000 investment to a prospective student.
 



 •      You are digitally savvy — fluent in CRM systems, WhatsApp Business, dialers, and virtual meeting tools.
 



 •      You can operate in a fast\-changing, start\-up\-like environment where process is still being built.
 



  





***Experience and Qualifications:***




 •      5\+ years of hardcore sales experience, including 3\+ years specifically selling online degree, certificate, or high\-ticket ed\-tech programs (ARPU $3,000–$10,000\).
 



 •      Proven, verifiable track record of consistently meeting or exceeding high\-volume outbound sales targets (calls, conversions, revenue).
 



 •      Demonstrated ability to sustain a high daily call volume (120\+ dials/day) as a core, ongoing part of the role — not an occasional push.
 



 •      Experience managing a multi\-channel sales cadence (phone, email, WhatsApp, live chat) with prospects across a multi\-week decision cycle.
 



 •      Prior experience in ed\-tech, online higher education, or online professional certification sales strongly preferred; awareness of the UK/international online education market is a plus.
 



 •      Strong negotiation and objection\-handling skills, particularly around price, ROI, and the credibility of online qualifications.
 



 •      Resilience and composure under pressure — able to handle rejection\-heavy days without a dip in performance.
 



 •      Proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce/HubSpot/Meritto), Microsoft Office/Excel, and WhatsApp Business tools.
 



 •      Excellent spoken and written English; proficiency in Hindi and other languages a plus.
 



 •   Bachelor's degree required.

 In a world where you can be anything,
 **Be Infoblox** 
 .
   

  

**Sales Engineer – APJ**
 We have an opportunity for a Sales Engineer \- APJ to join our APJ sales team, reporting to the Senior Director, Sales Engineering and PSS. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor to our customers and partners, providing presales consultation, solution recommendations, and hands\-on support to help identify business challenges and propose effective technical designs and solutions. Collaborating closely with sales, channel and cross\-functional teams to drive revenue growth through high\-touch presales engagements and end\-to\-end technical guidance throughout the entire sales cycle \- from initial discovery to successful deal closure. At Infoblox, you will thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment that values excellence, continuous learning, and career development.
   

  

**Be a Contributor \- What You’ll Do**
* Lead customer value discovery to uncover critical pains with Inside Sales Representatives, desired outcomes, and decision criteria; translate these into measurable hypotheses, KPIs, and executive win\-themes that guide the sales strategy
* Diagnose the customer’s current state and design the desired future state architecture, mapping Infoblox capabilities to quantified business outcomes, risk reduction, and time\-to\-value
* Build executive\-ready ROI/TCO models and qualified business cases that articulate economic impact, cost of inaction, productivity gains, and operational risk mitigation
* Plan and execute PoV engagements with clear success criteria tied to outcomes; baseline current performance, instruction telemetry, and validate value hypotheses with agreed metrics
* Drive a mutual evaluation plan with the account team and champion, aligning to Meddicc/Meddpicc elements (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria/Process, Paper Process, Identified Pain, Champion, Competition)
* Present value narratives to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including C\-level audiences, using clear storytelling that connects architecture choices to financial and operational results
* Differentiate against competitors using value\-based messaging – emphasize measurable outcomes, total economic impact, and unique risk coverage rather than feature parity
* Collaborate on pricing and packaging anchored in delivered value; recommend right\-sized scopes, phased value realization, and reference architectures that accelerate adoption
* Maintain rigorous SFDC hygiene and cadence: document value hypotheses, PoV success criteria, metrics status, economic buyer access, and next best actions throughout the cycle
* Capture validated outcomes and customer references; contribute quantified value stories, templates, ROI calculators, and playbook assets back to the field for reuse
* Leverage AI\-enabled presales workflows across discovery, solutioning, and execution: account research, call note summarization, action\-item extraction, competitive analysis, RFP/RFI drafting, demo/storyline generation, and PoV telemetry analysis tied to value metrics
* Build and maintain reusable AI prompt libraries, templates, and governed knowledge bases to ground outputs in approved content; continuously refine prompts for accuracy and tone
* Enable the field on best practices by sharing playbooks, AI use case, reusable assets, and lessons learned that measurably improve response speed, deal quality, and cycle time


**Be Prepared \- What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in sales engineering or customer\-facing presales technical presales role, preferably within a direct sales environment
* Strong hands\-on expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity technologies
* Demonstrated ability to run value selling motions end to end: discovery, diagnosis, quantification (ROI/TCO), PoV proof, executive business case, and value realization handoff
* Proven experience designing and conducting PoV engagements with outcome\-based success criteria and telemetry\-driven valuation
* Working proficiency with value\-based selling frameworks (eg. MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN) including access to the economic buyer and clear definition of metrics and decision criteria
* Practical experience with AI tools in presales (eg. LLM copilots, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, summarization, translation, and data analysis) to accelerate discovery notes, RFP/RFI responses, demo storylines, competitive battlecards, and PoV telemetry analysis
* Strong operational discipline with SFDC and presales processes; consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets and improving win rates through value\-based approaches and AI\-enabled productivity
* Exceptional communication and executive storytelling skills; able to simplify complex technical concepts and link them to business and financial outcomes
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, start\-up environment, with a proactive and hands\-on approach to problem\-solving and cross\-functional collaboration


**Be Successful \- Your Path**
**First 90 Days:** 
 Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work. Stand up AI\-assisted value discovery guides, an approved prompt library grounded in corporate content, and standard PoV success criteria and dashboards for your key segments.
   

  

**Six Months:** 
 Work autonomously in sales engagement and technical discussion, conducting PoC/PoV independently, and use functional teams to provide additional support. Deliver multiple quantified business cases and PoVs that validate outcomes against baseline metrics; demonstrate measurable improvements in proposal/RFP turnaround and MEDDICC completeness via AI workflows.
   

  

**One Year:** 
 Own your domain, mentor the next newcomer, create and recommend new product features and enhancements, speaking in webinars, marketing events and/or writing technical blogs, and meet or exceed your annual targets. Be recognized for advancing value selling excellence, codifying AI\-enabled presales practices, and capturing customer outcome stories that raise win rates and shorten cycle times.
   

  

**Belong—** 
**Your Community**
 Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here. Click here to learn more about life as a Bloxer.
   

  

**Be Rewarded —** 
**Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**
* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options.
* Learning opportunities, career\-mobility programs, and leadership workshops.
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy.
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations.
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match.


 Ready to
 **Be the Difference?**

description:
**About TrueFoundry**
 Every production AI system whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
   

  

**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
 We are looking for an Account Executive to join the team.
   

  

**The Problem We're Solving**
 Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self\-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi\-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
   

  

 The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct\-tape together a few API calls and call it production\-ready.
   

  

**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**
* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self\-hosted models, custom tools, and agents


**AI Gateway** 
 is the control plane five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
   

  

 We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with the founder on strategic initiatives and special projects that result in resulting in "X" ARR
* Generate high\-potential leads through discovery calls, LinkedIn, and email campaigns and grow a sales pipeline.
* Create product presentations and conduct discovery calls.
* Manage End\-to\-End Sales process (Inbound Leads to Closure)
* Run outbound and inbound experiments
* End to ownership of growth initiatives like newsletters, events, etc. to build the inbound funnel.
* Strive to continuously improve your sales process and demonstrate a willingness to learn and implement best practices
* Manage outsourced agencies and vendors for social media promotions and lead generations


**Traits we are looking for:** 
 Ownership, ability to execute, hustle and think out of the box, data driven decision making, be comfortable with more unknowns than knowns.
   

  

**Perks of Working at TrueFoundry**
* Join a fast\-growing Series A, Bay Area\-based startup building cutting\-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
   

  

 As a hybrid Account Executive/Account Manager in our Mid\-Market segment (companies of 250 to 1,000 employees), based in our future Apollo Bangalore office, you drive net\-new outbound revenue across a territory of accounts and own the ongoing activation, expansion and renewal of a Tier 1/Tier 2 book you have already closed or inherited.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* Single point of contact end to end: outbound prospecting, discovery, demo, pricing, negotiation, procurement and close, then ongoing activation, expansion and renewal
* Own a combined territory of net\-new outbound accounts and an existing Tier 1/Tier 2 book \[size to confirm with RevOps — dedicated MM AE territories run 600\+ accounts, dedicated AM books are smaller and higher\-touch; expect a reduced blended number here]
* Partner closely with Sales Development Managers on outreach for the new\-business side, and with Customer Success, Support and Product on the account\-management side
* Based in Bangalore, open to in\-office presence once office opens


**Pipeline and sales process execution**
* Manage the entire sales process, new and existing, from first touch through discovery, demonstration, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal and close, inside an average cycle of 60 days or less
* Generate the large majority of new\-business pipeline through outbound prospecting into your territory, and manage the pipeline surfaced from within your existing book
* Run 4 or more meetings per day and 20 or more per week, combined across new\-business and account\-management work
* Develop a pipeline that is majority self\-sourced through outbound on the new\-business side \[confirm target mix — dedicated MM AE benchmark is 90% net\-new outbound; AM benchmark blends inbound and account planning], and consistently hold 3x pipeline coverage based on a 40% win rate
* Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly quotas for new\-business bookings and net revenue retention
* Own your schedule across research, initial meetings, platform demos, CRM hygiene, escalations, follow\-up meetings, business reviews and pricing calls
* Conduct customer meetings and account touches at a pace to be set by RevOps


**Sales strategy and deal management**
* Use a data\-driven approach to tier your account list, both for new\-business targeting and for identifying top expansion and at\-risk accounts within your book
* Run consultative discovery, asking layered questions and tying findings back to business outcomes, on new deals and existing accounts alike
* Communicate directly with Director and above contacts in Sales, Marketing and RevOps, and multi\-thread across departments
* Partner with Sales Development Managers on strategic outreach campaigns for the new\-business side
* Build detailed account plans for the top 20% of your book, focused on growth strategy and expansion opportunities
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of existing accounts' product usage to identify activation and adoption opportunities
* Articulate a clear view of your combined pipeline, deals and renewals at each stage, and forecast within a 10% margin
* Apply AI tooling to your own workflow to compress research, prep and follow\-up time across a broader scope of work than a single\-motion seat


**Mindset and culture**
* Thrive in a competitive environment, embracing challenges, enjoying objection handling and using setbacks as fuel
* Thrive with a high level of ambiguity and change while maintaining a customer\-centric approach at scale
* Take responsibility for successes and failures with a relentless drive to keep improving
* Be a self\-starter who stays motivated through repeated objections and repeated no on the new\-business side, and through slow\-moving accounts on the existing\-book side
* Sell as a team, proactively bringing leadership into deals and customer situations
* Bring genuine curiosity about sales technology, customer business models and industry trends

Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology\- enabling faster, better, connected insights.

With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. In this role you will make over 100 calls per day to healthcare providers. As Outreach Specialist you will be the voice of Konovo as you speak with Healthcare Providers across the globe about the opportunities to participate in healthcare market research that Konovo offers.
 



  





**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Ask a series of scripted questions over the telephone to determine whether research opportunities fit the prospective participant’s experience
* Use Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Salesforce to track efforts and communicate across departments

* Support operations team with independently managed phone\-based tasks such as reminder, confirmation, and scheduling calls to participants in research studies
* Ensure production
 
 goals of needed participants are met through effective execution
* Provide proactive feedback about production barriers to senior team members and problem solve to address them



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 3\+ years of experience in English outbound or inbound call center or sales operations, preferably within the healthcare or life sciences industry.
* A proactive and strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven track record of hitting or exceeding outbound pipeline targets
* High level of proficiency in English, enabling the ability to confidently and effectively engage with physician offices and other key contacts
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to work in cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams)
* Adaptability to thrive in a fast\-changing environment while navigating challenges collaboratively.
* High attention to detail and proven ability to work in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Why Join Konovo?** 



* Be part of a mission\-driven organisation that is empowering life science researchers and data scientists with the broadest ecosystem of healthcare audiences and an intelligent, AI\-enabled platform — so insights aren't just collected, they're connected.
* Join a fast\-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility.
* Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well\-being, and balance.
* Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well\-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee\-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience.
* Make a real\-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster.



  





 If you’re eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research — and you’re smart, nice, and driven to make an impact — we’d love to hear from you!

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Business Development Executive** 




**Loop by Zolo** 




**Build supply. Drive owner partnerships. Create the foundation for Loop’s expansion.** 




  





**Offered CTC:** 
 4\.5 LPA to 5\.5 LPA
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Loop by Zolo is scaling its presence across cities by partnering with property owners and building vibrant, community\-led stays designed for young travellers.
 



 Growth starts with finding the right properties and the right owners.
 



 The challenge is not just identifying potential properties — it is
 **building trust with owners, understanding the asset, running structured conversations, and consistently moving opportunities forward** 
 .
 



 Most conversations do not convert because of poor follow\-ups, unstructured pitching, lack of persistence, or a mismatch between the property and what the business needs.
 



 This role exists to ensure that:
 


* Every owner interaction is
 **thoughtful and structured**
* Every potential property is
 **understood and qualified**
* Every opportunity is
 **tracked and progressed**
* Every conversation contributes to a
 **growing, high\-quality supply pipeline**



 If the Business Development Executive is strong, the supply pipeline builds consistently and the right properties move towards closure.
 



 If the Business Development Executive is weak, opportunities drop, follow\-ups break, unsuitable properties consume time, and expansion slows.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of property owner conversations
* Identify properties that could fit the Loop proposition
* Drive consistent outreach and field meetings
* Run structured, insight\-driven owner conversations
* Understand owner expectations and identify deal blockers
* Ensure disciplined follow\-ups and deal progression
* Maintain clean and reliable pipeline data



 This is not a coordination role.
 



 It is a
 **field\-driven, execution\-heavy, ownership role** 
 with direct impact on Loop’s expansion.
 



  





**About Zolo and Loop** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



**Loop by Zolo creates vibrant, community\-led stays for young travellers — bringing together comfortable accommodation, shared experiences, and spaces designed for connection.** 




 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.
 



 Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**Drive Outreach \& Build Supply Pipeline** 



* Identify and reach out to property owners in assigned markets
* Build a consistent pipeline of potential Loop properties
* Generate new owner and property leads regularly
* Build local networks and identify potential supply opportunities
* Maintain strong meeting cadence across weeks
* Avoid pipeline gaps due to inconsistent outreach



**Identify \& Understand Potential Properties** 



* Understand the property, location, configuration, and owner expectations
* Gather relevant information required for initial property evaluation
* Understand whether the property broadly fits Loop’s business requirements
* Identify obvious gaps or concerns early in the conversation
* Ensure relevant property information is captured accurately
* Coordinate next steps for properties that qualify for further evaluation



**Run Structured Owner Conversations** 



* Understand the owner’s context, asset, expectations, and priorities before pitching
* Follow a clear conversation flow —
 **context → need → opportunity → solution**
* Explain the Loop proposition clearly and confidently
* Help owners understand how a partnership with Loop could work
* Avoid random or premature pitching
* Build credibility and trust through every interaction



**Capture Insights \& Objections** 



* Document owner feedback and objections accurately
* Understand what is preventing an owner from moving forward
* Identify common patterns across owner conversations
* Share market and owner insights with the team
* Maintain high\-quality information for reviews and coaching
* Convert field conversations into actionable learning



**Drive Follow\-ups \& Deal Movement** 



* Ensure timely and consistent follow\-ups for every opportunity
* Maintain clear next steps for all active leads
* Keep qualified properties moving through the supply funnel
* Coordinate site visits, discussions, documentation, and internal evaluation wherever required
* Prevent opportunities from becoming stagnant due to poor follow\-through
* Maintain ownership until there is a clear outcome



**Maintain CRM \& Process Discipline** 



* Update CRM after every meaningful interaction
* Maintain accurate property information and deal stages
* Ensure no opportunity is lost due to poor tracking
* Maintain clear visibility of next steps and timelines
* Follow defined BD processes and playbooks
* Enable clean pipeline reviews and forecasting



**Operate with High Energy in the Field** 



* Travel extensively across assigned locations for owner meetings and property visits
* Maintain consistency in effort across multiple conversations and meetings
* Be comfortable exploring new markets and identifying opportunities on ground
* Handle rejection without a drop in energy
* Stay proactive and responsive in owner interactions
* Demonstrate strong field hustle and ownership



  





**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 



* Consistent owner outreach and meeting cadence
* Strong pipeline of relevant properties across assigned markets
* Better qualification of properties before they move deeper into the funnel
* High\-quality and structured owner conversations
* Clean and reliable CRM data for reviews
* Consistent follow\-ups across active opportunities
* Steady movement of qualified properties through the supply funnel
* Strong understanding of assigned markets and owner dynamics
* High reliability — commitments consistently delivered



 The supply pipeline feels
 **active, relevant, structured, and consistently moving forward** 
 .
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You are comfortable spending significant time in the field
* You enjoy meeting property owners and building new relationships
* You are curious about properties, locations, and how businesses operate
* You can handle rejection and continue with high energy
* You are comfortable initiating conversations with people you have never met before
* You prefer structured execution over ad\-hoc working
* You are willing to learn and improve quickly
* You take ownership of your output and follow\-through
* You enjoy building something from the ground up



  





**Experience we value** 



* 0–2 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Real Estate, Hospitality, Property Acquisition, or other customer\-facing roles
* Freshers with strong business development and field\-sales inclination may be considered
* Comfort with extensive travel and field work
* Strong communication skills and confidence in conversations
* Ability to build relationships with property owners

 . As a global leader in
 **robotic\-assisted surgery** 
 and
 **minimally invasive care** 
 , our technologies—like the
 **da Vinci surgical system**

Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.
   

  

 This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. * Bring relevant clinical and workflow value during the initial surgeon case series and support continuous improvement as experience develops.
* Develop and lead regional specialty education and market development programs that can scale adoption.
* Build Clinical, Operational, and Economic Value
* Work with surgeon champions, care teams, and internal partners to identify and develop credible clinical, operational, and economic value evidence.
* Understand customer success measures within the operating room and across the patient pathway, and translate them into account\-specific value discussions.
* Partner with relevant internal functions to develop value\-focused steering committees, executive reviews, and customer action plans.
* Conduct hospital, department, and practice executive presentations that support informed decision\-making and program expansion.
* Use approved evidence, customer data, and value tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.

* Leverage specialty resources to support scalable launches of new procedures, products, advanced technologies, and customer programs.

 Skills Required

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Sales Executive** 




  





**Location:** 
 Mumbai, New Delhi, and Kolkata, India
 



**Experience:** 
 2\-4 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Ultrafresh is a leading modular kitchen and home interior brand transforming houses into stylish, functional homes. Powered by the TTK Prestige Group, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, with regional offices in Delhi, Bengaluru, and Kolkata and more than 200 studios across India. Ultrafresh serves customers through kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, combining design\-led thinking with practical home solutions. Its advanced manufacturing capabilities and focus on innovation support consistent product quality and scalable customer delivery. The business blends craftsmanship and technology to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality, while its studio network enables local engagement and consultation. As one of India’s fastest\-growing home lifestyle brands, Ultrafresh is expanding its reach by connecting customers with solutions tailored to their requirements, budgets, and living spaces. The company’s sales teams play a direct role in converting customer needs into satisfying, commercially successful home interior outcomes.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Sales Executive, you will own customer acquisition and revenue development across your assigned local market. You will generate demand through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationships with customers, architects, interior designers, builders, and relevant businesses. Through face\-to\-face consultations, you will understand requirements, present suitable modular kitchen and home interior solutions, and convert qualified opportunities into sales. You will manage the sales pipeline, maintain accurate interaction records, negotiate pricing and terms, and prioritize opportunities that improve conversion and commercial outcomes. Success means building a reliable local customer base, strengthening relationships through responsive solution selling, and consistently achieving assigned sales targets. This is an onsite, field\-oriented role requiring regular travel, customer meetings, independent execution, and ownership of the complete sales process.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Generate qualified local leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and relationship\-led outreach, expanding the opportunity base and improving the consistency of customer acquisition.
* Identify prospective customers, businesses, architects, interior designers, and builders whose requirements align with Ultrafresh’s modular home solutions and commercial growth priorities.
* Conduct face\-to\-face meetings, diagnose customer requirements, and present relevant kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliance solutions that improve fit, confidence, and conversion.
* Build trusted customer relationships through timely follow\-up and responsive engagement, protecting satisfaction while increasing referrals, repeat opportunities, and successful project progression.
* Own the sales pipeline by tracking opportunity stages, prioritizing high\-potential prospects, and maintaining accurate customer interaction records for disciplined follow\-through.
* Analyse customer needs and recommend effective solutions, balancing functional requirements, design expectations, pricing considerations, and commercial feasibility during the sales process.
* Negotiate pricing and terms within approved parameters, protecting customer value and business margins while moving qualified opportunities toward closure.
* Deliver assigned sales targets and objectives by managing daily field activity, conversion priorities, and pipeline coverage across the local base location.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to customer conversations, enabling clear recommendations, credible value articulation, and commercially sound closures.
* Demonstrate independence and teamwork in a field\-sales environment, taking ownership of local execution while coordinating effectively with internal colleagues and customer stakeholders.
* Communicate fluently in English and Hindi, with proficiency in at least one regional language, to build trust and conduct effective consultations across the assigned market.
* Apply structured pipeline management and accurate customer\-record discipline to prioritize opportunities, maintain visibility, and improve follow\-up quality throughout the sales cycle.
* Use customer\-need analysis and consultative selling to connect individual requirements with suitable modular products, supporting stronger conversion and customer satisfaction.
* Own a two\-wheeler and be prepared for regular field travel, customer meetings, networking, and face\-to\-face business development within the local market.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling modular kitchens, home interiors, or other modular products can shorten the learning curve and strengthen solution credibility with customers.
* Existing relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, or local business networks can accelerate qualified lead generation and improve market access.
* A proven record of meeting sales targets in the local base location demonstrates the commercial ownership needed to succeed in this role.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring at least two years of direct, field, or B2C sales experience, with evidence that you can build a local pipeline and convert opportunities into measurable revenue.
* You communicate confidently in English and Hindi and can engage customers in at least one regional language, adapting your presentation to different needs, backgrounds, and decision\-making styles.
* You are comfortable working independently in the field while contributing to a team environment, taking responsibility for prospecting, meetings, follow\-ups, records, negotiations, and target delivery.
* You listen carefully to customer requirements and translate them into practical product recommendations, helping prospects understand the value of modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances.
* You bring disciplined pipeline habits, accurate record keeping, and consistent follow\-through so every qualified opportunity receives the right attention at the right stage.
* You own a two\-wheeler and are willing to travel locally for customer meetings, networking, referrals, and relationship development.
* Familiarity with modular or concept\-based product selling, plus an existing network among architects, interior designers, or builders, will help you create momentum faster.
* Most importantly, you are commercially driven, relationship\-oriented, and motivated by achieving clear sales objectives while ensuring customers receive solutions that fit their practical and lifestyle requirements.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a fast\-growing home lifestyle brand with more than 200 studios across India, giving you access to a broad market and meaningful local sales opportunities.
* Sell a differentiated portfolio spanning modular kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, and appliances, allowing you to solve complete home improvement needs rather than isolated product requirements.
* Work with the backing of the TTK Prestige Group while combining craftsmanship, technology, and innovation to create spaces that reflect each customer’s personality.
* Build a career in consultative field sales where disciplined execution, customer relationships, and measurable commercial outcomes directly shape business growth.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A role with direct ownership of local market development, customer acquisition, pipeline quality, negotiations, and sales\-target achievement.
* Exposure to a growing home interiors business with a broad product portfolio, studio network, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and opportunities to build valuable market relationships.
* A customer\-facing environment where strong performance can be demonstrated through qualified lead generation, conversion, relationship quality, and consistent commercial delivery.

title: Associate Key Account Manager (Sales)
description:
**Openings – 2 in Mumbai** 




**Experience \-** 

 0\-2 years in any service selling: insurance, edtech, fintech, real estate, hospitality, SaaS, staffing, telecom. Freshers with genuine hustle welcome.
 












**Build, Plan \& Close ₹1 crore worth multi media campaigns before you turn 25\.** 




 Excellent Publicity is a full\-service advertising and media agency. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000\+ brands including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM\-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000\+ successful campaigns, spanning hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer \& sports.
 



  





 We are an energetic young team of almost 100 people across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru \& Dubai, with a strong in\-house tech team building superlative AI\-powered products, having built \& released two such products already: EPitch, which builds detailed media plans \& strategies in hours that most agencies take a fortnight to produce, and Atlas, which makes offline advertising as measurable \& transparent as digital.
 



  





 We are hiring Associate Key Account Managers into four sales pods. This is not a support role. From month three you carry your own accounts, your own target and your own incentive cheque.
 











**What you will actually do:** 




 • Entire World is your territory. You decide which brands are worth chasing and you build the list yourself, along with the inbound inquiries, referrals \& research based potentials.
 



 • Get to the decision maker. Marketing Heads, CMOs, founders. Cold calls, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, walk\-ins, industry events. We do not prescribe the method, we look at the meetings.
 



 • Sit in the pitch. In the room from week one. Presenting parts of it yourself by the end of quarter one.
 



 • Build the commercial. Work with our media team to turn a client brief into a media plan, a costing and a proposal that wins.
 



 • Close, then keep. Renewals and upsells on your own accounts earn you incentive again. The book you build is the book you are paid on.
 











**Your first 90 days:** 




**1st \& 2** 
**nd**
**Week\-** 
 Media 101, how OOH, print, radio, cinema, TV and digital are actually bought and priced. Shadow live client calls. Be in the room in real client meetings.
 



**3rd \- 6** 
**th**
**Week\-** 
 Build your prospect list. First 100 outbound conversations. Sit in on live pitches. Also handle our inbound inquiries from our Media buying platform as well as the GTM we run.
 



**7** 
**th**
**\- 12** 
**th**
**Week** 
 \- Run your own first\-meeting pitches. Co\-own live proposals. First closure expected inside month four.
 



  





**What you will earn:** 




**Salary Range** 
 \- ₹3,60,000 \- ₹5,00,000 p.a.
 



**Incentive \-** 
 Uncapped, linked to gross profit on every deal you close, paid quarterly
 



 Realistic Year\-1 total, on target ₹6,20,000 \- ₹8,00,000
 



 Fixed band is benchmarked to experience. The incentive is where the money is, and there is no ceiling on it. Our strongest performers have crossed ₹10 L in total earnings inside two years.
 











**Who we are looking for:** 




 • You can hold a conversation with someone twenty years senior without folding.
 



 • You are fine being told "no" eight times before you get a "yes".
 



 • You write a clear email and put together a decent PowerPoint.
 



 • You are curious about brands, why they advertise where they do, and why they spend what they spend.
 



 • Fluent English and Hindi. Gujarati is a strong plus for Ahmedabad; Marathi for Mumbai.
 



 • Any graduate. A track record of selling something, even a college fest sponsorship, matters more than the degree.
 



 Not required: advertising experience, an MBA, or a marketing degree. We have built strong sellers out of people from insurance, edtech inside sales, telecom, real estate and retail.
 











**How to apply:** 




 Do not send only a CV. We get hundreds and most read identical.
 



 Send two things to chahal@excellentpublicity.com or WhatsApp \+917486031011
 



 1\. 
 **Your CV.** 




 2\. 
 **A 60\-second voice note answering:** 
 "Pick any brand you have noticed advertising in your city in the last month. Where did you see it, and who do you think they were trying to reach?"
 



 There is no right answer. We are listening for how you think and how you speak, which is the job.

Call scripts, objection handling, ICP refinement, competitive battlecards, CRM hygiene, separately for each market. What we're looking for Previous experienc closing enterprise deals. ServiceChannel is the leading cloud\-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. We are committed to creating a great product for our customers and a great work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally.
   

  

 ServiceChannel is seeking an experienced Commercial Relationship Manager (RM) to join our India Delivery Center (IDC) in Bangalore. This is a customer\-facing role responsible for owning the commercial lifecycle for a high\-volume portfolio of SMB and Small Commercial customers, including renewals and expansion (upsell/cross\-sell). The RM executes structured, repeatable commercial motions at scale while partnering closely with Customer Success (CSM) who owns product adoption and engagement programs.
   

  

 This role will support our Global customer base with primary account ownership across United States (majority) and Europe (minority). The roles will scale to align to U.S. and Europe business hours; working with customers across all U.S. and European time zones.

* Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to incorporate adoption and customer health signals into renewal and expansion prioritization; support (but do not own) EBR preparation and follow\-up by providing commercial context and next steps.

**WE’RE HIRING \| FOUNDER’S OFFICE ASSOCIATE** 




  





**ROLE DETAILS**

**Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





**ABOUT ORCHARD GATE** 




 Orchard Gate is a specialty coffee sourcing and export business connecting global coffee buyers with Indian coffee origins. nWe work with coffee estates and producers across India, sourcing and developing coffees across different origins, processes and quality profiles, and working with specialty coffee roasters, importers and buyers across India and international markets.
 



 The business operates at the intersection of specialty coffee, agriculture, international trade, sales and brand building.
 



  





**Learn more:** 




**🌐** 
 orchardgatellc.com
 



**💼 Orchard Gate on** 
 LinkedIn
 




  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We’re looking for a
 **smart, curious and highly driven generalist** 
 to work closely with the founder.
 



 This is not a typical “job description” where you do one function every day.
 



 One day you might be:
 



 → Finding 50 potential coffee buyers in a new country
 



 → Figuring out who the right decision\-maker is and writing to them
 



 The next day:
 



 → Researching a new market
 



 → Building a database or analysing a business opportunity
 



 → Working on an Instagram idea around an estate or coffee origin
 



 → Preparing a client presentation
 



 And another day:
 



 → Coordinating samples with a producer
 



 → Following up with an international buyer
 



 → Helping put together a new business proposal
 



 → Figuring out how to solve something that nobody has given you instructions for
 



**You’ll work directly with the founder, and your work will have a visible impact on the business.** 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON** 




  





 BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND GROWTH
 



 A significant part of your role will involve
 **finding and developing new business opportunities.** 




**→ Research domestic and international coffee buyers** 




**→ Identify potential clients and decision\-makers** 




**→ Build prospect databases and lead lists** 




**→ Conduct email, LinkedIn and other outbound outreach** 




**→ Manage follow\-ups and CRM** 




**→ Support sample requests, proposals and commercial discussions** 




**→ Identify new markets, customers and business opportunities** 




  





 RESEARCH AND PROBLEM SOLVING
 



 → Research markets, companies, competitors and industries
 



 → Turn messy information into structured insights
 



 → Build databases and research frameworks
 



 → Answer questions like
 *“Who should we sell to?”* 
 ,
 *“Which market should we explore?”* 
 and
 *“How do we reach them?”* 




  





 MARKETING AND BRAND
 



 → Develop content ideas around coffee, estates, producers and origins
 



 → Work on Instagram and other digital initiatives
 



 → Assist with presentations, proposals and brand material
 



 → Help figure out how Orchard Gate should tell its story
   





 FOUNDERS OFFICE
 


 → Coordinate samples, vendors, clients and shipments
 




 → Support events and partnerships
 



 → Work on new projects and business ideas
 



 → Take projects from
 **idea → execution** 




**→ Jump into whatever important problem needs solving that week** 




  





**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




 We're looking for
 **smart people who are curious about how businesses work.** 




 You might be a great fit if you:
 



 ● Learn quickly and enjoy figuring things out
 



 ● Are naturally curious and ask
 **“why?”** 
 and
 **“what if?”** 




 ● Can research something you've never heard of and make sense of it
 



 ● Are comfortable talking to strangers and reaching out to potential clients
 



 ● Write and communicate clearly
 



 ● Are comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, presentations and digital tools
 



 ● Can take a vague problem and turn it into an actionable plan
 



 ● Don't need someone to tell you what to do at every step
 



 ● Are organised, resourceful and detail\-oriented
 



 ● Actually enjoy startups, business and entrepreneurship
 



**You don't need to know coffee.** 




 You don't need to have done everything listed here.
 



 What matters more is
 **how quickly you learn, how you think and how much ownership you take.** 




  





 A GOOD FIT IF
 



 You see an unfamiliar problem and your first instinct is:
 



**“Okay, let me figure this out.”** 




 You enjoy going down a research rabbit hole and coming back with something useful.
 



 You're comfortable sending the first email, making the first call, finding the missing contact, building the spreadsheet, fixing the presentation or figuring out the process.
 



 And you want to understand
 **how a business actually gets built** 
 , rather than just learn one narrow function.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL GET** 




 You'll work directly with the founder and get exposure to:
 


* Specialty Coffee
* Agriculture \& Coffee Sourcing
* B2B Sales \& Business Development
* International Trade \& Exports
* Market Research \& Business Strategy
* Marketing \& Brand Building
* Entrepreneurship \& Operations



  





 You'll see the entire chain \-
 **from producer and coffee farm to international customer.** 




 And because we're a growing business,
 **good ideas don't stay ideas for long.** 




 If you come up with something that makes sense, you'll likely get the chance to actually build it.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Please email your CV to:
 



 📩
 **trade@mg\-resorts.com** 




 Please include:
 


* College \& degree
* GPA / academic percentage
* Graduation year
* Relevant internships/projects
* A short introduction about yourself and why you’re interested in a Founder’s Office role



  





**Subject: Founder’s Office Associate \- \[Your Name]** 




  





 If you're someone who likes learning fast, figuring things out and being close to the action \- we'd love to hear from you.

 Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide.
